name: Language name, as its speakers write it
notes: Translate the values, keep the keys. Keep every {placeholder} exactly as it is, in any order. Lists must keep their number of entries. Chat commands such as !join stay as they are. Leave out anything not translated yet; it stays English.

strings.UI_SETTINGS_EXP_TIMES_HINT: Pick as many as you like.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_FOOTER: Changes apply right away and are saved when you close settings.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_FPS_HINT: A lower limit saves power and keeps the computer cool while streaming.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_FREE_SPEED_HINT: Hold Shift to fly five times faster and Alt to go slower. Keypad + and - still adjust it while flying.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_HIDE_LOGOS_HINT: Player and clan logos show a plain image instead, everywhere. Shortcut: {0}.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_HOUSES_HINT: Moves players into village houses that have nobody living in them.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_INVERT_LOOK_HINT: Moving the mouse up looks down.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_KEYS_FIXED: Esc always opens the menu and backs out of windows, and the free camera flies with WASD, Q and E.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_KEYS_HINT: Click a key to change it, then press the new one. Esc cancels, Backspace leaves it unbound. A key already in use swaps over.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LABELS_HINT: Text and json files your streaming software can show.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LABELS_JSON_HINT: The same values as json, for overlays that read data.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LABELS_TEXT_HINT: One plain text file per value, the easiest to add as a text source in OBS.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LANGUAGE_HINT: For the interface and the bot's messages in your chat. A few windows switch over when the game reloads.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOCAL_BOT: Accept a bot on this computer
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOCAL_BOT_HINT: For streamers who run RavenBot themselves.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOCAL_PORT_HINT: The port a bot on this computer connects to.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOOK_HINT: Turning speed while holding the right mouse button or Ctrl in the free camera.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOOT_ORIGIN_HINT: !loot replies tell whether each item dropped in a raid or a dungeon.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_MASTER_HINT: All of the game's sound at once.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_MUSIC_HINT: The background music and the raid music.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NAMES_HINT: The name tags above characters in the world.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_DUNGEONS_HINT: No dungeons start at all, neither on their own nor by chat command.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_EXP: Warn players who gain no exp
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_EXP_HINT: The bot points anyone training where they gain nothing to a better island.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_EXP_TIME_HINT: Later warnings wait five times as long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_RAIDS_HINT: No raids start at all, neither on their own nor by chat command.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_EMPTY_HINT: Islands with nobody on them still get a turn in the island camera.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_EVENT: Time after a sub or a cheer
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_EVENT_HINT: The camera turns to whoever subscribed or cheered.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_HINT: How long the camera stays on a player before it moves on.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_ISLAND_HINT: How long the island camera shows each island before moving to the next.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_MOD_HINT: When the camera picks a moderator, it stays on them at least this long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_SUB_HINT: When the camera picks a subscriber, it stays on them at least this long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_VIP_HINT: When the camera picks a VIP, it stays on them at least this long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PATHFINDING_HINT: How much time players get to find their way each frame. Higher is smoother with many players, and costs more CPU.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PHYSICS_HINT: Simulated physics in the world. Off saves CPU with many players. Shortcut: {0}.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PLAYER_DETAILS_HINT: The panel for the player the camera is watching. Shortcut: {0}.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PLAYER_LIST_HINT: The list of everyone playing. {0} also hides it, with the rest of the interface.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_POTATO_HINT: The lowest graphics there are, for computers that are struggling.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_QUALITY_HINT: Lower levels draw fewer shadows and effects, for slower computers.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_QUERY_ADDRESS_HINT: Where the API listens, as host:port/path.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_QUERY_HINT: A local web API with the game's data, for overlays and tools.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_REALTIME_HINT: Day and night follow the time on this computer.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_RESET_PAGE_HINT: Puts every setting on this page back to its default
strings.UI_SETTINGS_RESET_WINDOWS_HINT: Puts every window back where it started.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_RESOLUTION_HINT: Draws the world at a lower resolution to save GPU time.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_SCREEN_SIZE_HINT: The size the game draws at.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_SHORTCUTS_HINT: The row of keyboard shortcuts along the bottom.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_TIME_HINT: Used while the day and night cycle is off.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_VIEW_DISTANCE_HINT: How far away the world is still drawn. Lower is faster.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_VSYNC_HINT: Matches the monitor's refresh rate and stops tearing. The frame rate limit is not used while it is on.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_WINDOW_MODE_HINT: Borderless fills the screen and is the quickest to switch away from while streaming.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_ZOOM_HINT: How far one turn of the wheel zooms the player and island cameras.
strings.UI_STREAMRAID_WAR_DECLARED: {0} has declared war with an army of {1}!
strings.UI_TIP_ARMOR_NOTE: Reduces damage taken from every attack style.
strings.UI_TIP_PET: Aww! What a cute little pet!
strings.UI_TOWN_UPGRADE_READY: A town hall upgrade is ready. Open build mode and select the town hall.
strings.UI_UPDATE_ERROR:
Error occurred when trying to update the game. 
Press space to open the log folder.
strings.UI_UPDATE_NO_CONNECTION: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your internet connection.
strings.UI_UPDATE_UP_TO_DATE: Game is up to date. Starting game...
strings.UI_WINDOW_RESIZE_WIDTH: Drag to make wider or narrower
